incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered at 4445001234 — deploy canary -> EU-west showing 502/5xx spike for text-gen-proxy. Error-rate 18% over 5m. Suspected feature flag: prefetch_v2_enabled.

maria: Oncall (maria) — I'm looking. Which deploy rolled the canary? @kevin?

kevin: I kicked off the canary this morning, 10% traffic. Seeing a KV cache miss storm in logs and backend 502s. Starting rollback now. Command: `deploy rollback canary-2026-03-17-02` ETA ~3m.

incident-bot: Status changed to investigating — rollback initiated by kevin.

jamie: FYI CS dashboard shows 5 customers with elevated 500s (support IDs: 83, 112, 119, 202, 278). Creating incident ticket INC-5621 for customer comms.

maria: If rollback doesn't clear, flip kill-switch for the flag: `POST https://console.internal/api/ff/kill/prefetch_v2` (use SRE token). Also capture `kubectl logs` for the text-gen-proxy pods before any rotation.

kevin: Rollback finished at 4445001248 — canary rolled back to previous stable. Metrics: error-rate down to 0.9% within 30s. :thumbsup:

samir: Confirming latency and error-rate back to baseline in eu-west. I'll run the prefetch perf regression suite and hold the flag paused.

maria: Good. Handoff to @jamie for customer follow-ups and incident doc. I'll hand on-call to @samir in 15m. Please label postmortem and assign to eng-runtime.

console-bot: Deploy job canary-2026-03-17-02 rollback completed by kevin at 4445001248. Logs: https://deploys.internal/jobs/1234
